about: a question about a current event the website chatbot must look up

json.chatInput: Is the Lisbon ceramics fair still on this weekend, and what are the opening hours?

content.text: The Lisbon Ceramics Fair runs 14-17 November 2026 at Praça do Comércio, open 10:00-19:00 daily.

reads.note: agent tool: an HTTP Request tool POSTing a model-written Messages API body with Anthropic's server-side web_search tool (stored Anthropic credential); the same answer for every search, since the queries are model-written. On the n8n side api.anthropic.com/v1/messages is answered by this route before the shim's host forwarding

unfed.why: n8n's Think tool returns the model's own thought; nothing outside to feed

branches: no IF/Switch: the agent answers, optionally after web_search or Think calls
expect.offline: The agent picks web_search, Think or neither (model-driven); with canned replies it calls no tool. The web_search tool's own call to Anthropic is answered from the fixture, not by the model shim (a route wins over the shim's host forwarding). Simple Memory holds one turn per run.
expect.n8nCannotRun: the bench's stand-in model (haiku through the shim) calls an agent tool with an input the tool's schema refuses, on the release-5 recording pass's live draw (2026-11-16, replayed from the shim's cache on 2026-11-17) and on a fresh draw past the cache (2026-11-17), so n8n stops at AI Agent (`Received tool input did not match expected schema: Value must be a non-empty object or a non-empty array`) and nothing past it runs; the canned check of every variant runs to the end (PROPOSALS P134, run.mjs --record-only)
